remarks: Welcome to easy living in one of Stamford's most desirable full-service communities. This beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo combines modern comfort with a convenient location and resort-style amenities.  The freshly painted interior and new flooring create a bright, contemporary feel. The updated kitchen features sleek cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and ample counter space-perfect for cooking or entertaining. The bathroom has been tastefully renovated with modern fixtures and finishes for a move-in-ready experience.  The open-concept living and dining area leads to a private balcony at the quiet end of the corridor, offering extra privacy and a peaceful retreat. The primary bedroom includes generous closet space, while the second bedroom is ideal for guests or a home office.  Located on the third floor, this unit offers easy elevator access and a serene setting. Residents enjoy a secure, professionally managed building with a pool, fitness center, 24-hour security, and elegant lobby.  Just minutes from downtown Stamford's restaurants, shops, and entertainment, with easy access to Metro-North, parks, and major highways, this home offers the perfect blend of city convenience and everyday comfort. Move right in and enjoy the best of Stamford living!
